case.title: Yarn

design.purpose: A warm two-colour chunky neck cowl for one adult, crocheted flat in single crochet and joined end to end. Green for rows 1-8 and blue for rows 9-16.

steps.c: Place green yarn on the table
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch and each ch, 20 sc
Rows 2-4: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Rows 5-8: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Join blue, cut green leaving 15 cm tail
Rows 9-12: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Rows 13-16: ch 1, turn, 20 sc each row
Fasten off, cut blue leaving 40 cm tail
Whipstitch short ends together with blue tail
Weave all tails into nearby stitches, trim ends
